entries.evidence: addy.io's own browser extension lists 4wrd.cc among its shared alias domains, whose addresses forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mx1.4wrd.cc, the same mail server as mail.anonaddy.me).

addy.io's own browser extension lists addy.io among its shared alias domains, whose addresses forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mx1.addy.io, the same mail server as mail.anonaddy.me).

addy.io's own browser extension lists addy.to among its shared alias domains, whose addresses forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mx1.addy.to, the same mail server as mail.anonaddy.me).

addy.io's own browser extension lists addymail.com among its shared alias domains, whose addresses forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mx1.addymail.com, the same mail server as mail.anonaddy.me).
SimpleLogin hands out alias addresses on this domain and its subdomains that forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to SimpleLogin (mx1.simplelogin.co).
AliasVault's release notes say user email aliases use @aliasvault.net. At review, its MX routed to AliasVault's own mail server (mail.aliasvault.net).
addy.io (AnonAddy) aliases use username subdomains of this domain and forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mail.anonaddy.me).
addy.io (AnonAddy) offers this as a shared alias domain that forwards to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mail.anonaddy.me).
DuckDuckGo Email Protection hands out @duck.com addresses that forward to the owner's inbox. At review, its MX routed to DuckDuckGo (smtp-inbound1.duck.com).

addy.io's own browser extension lists mailer.me among its shared alias domains, whose addresses forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to addy.io (mx1.mailer.me, the same mail server as mail.anonaddy.me).

Firefox Relay masks use this domain and, for premium users, subdomains of it; mail is forwarded to the owner. At review, its MX routed to inbound mail processing (inbound-smtp.us-west-2.amazonaws.com).
Proton's blog shows a Proton Pass alias on @passmail.net forwarding to the owner's mailbox. At review, its MX routed to SimpleLogin (mx1.simplelogin.co), which runs Proton Pass aliases.
Apple's Hide My Email addresses use this domain and forward to the owner's real address. At review, its MX routed to Apple's relay (smtp1.privaterelay.appleid.com).

Firefox Relay's FAQ says masks used relay.firefox.com before the switch to mozmail.com; existing masks keep forwarding to the owner. At review, its MX routed to the same inbound mail processing as mozmail.com (inbound-smtp.us-west-2.amazonaws.com).
SimpleLogin hands out alias addresses on this domain that forward to the owner. At review, its MX routed to SimpleLogin (mx1.simplelogin.co).

SimpleLogin's documentation names @simplelogin.com among SimpleLogin alias domains, and username subdomains of it for aliases created on the fly. At review, its MX routed to SimpleLogin (mx1.simplelogin.co).
SimpleLogin's blog shows directory aliases on @simplelogin.fr forwarding to the owner. At review, its MX routed to SimpleLogin (mx1.simplelogin.co).

StartMail's alias page says personal and quick aliases end in @use.startmail.com and forward to the StartMail mailbox. At review, its MX routed to StartMail (mx1.startmail.com). Addresses on startmail.com itself are mailboxes and do not match.
ManyMe hands out @manyme.com alias addresses that forward to the owner's inbox. At review, its MX routed to inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com.
erine.email hands out @erine.email alias addresses that forward to the owner's inbox. At review, its MX routed to smtp-in.erine.email.
Bump (alias.email) hands out @bumpmail.io alias addresses that forward to the owner's inbox. At review, its MX routed to mx.bump.email.

33mail hands out alias addresses at <username>.33mail.com that forward to the owner's inbox; aliases live on subdomains, which this entry covers. At review, a user subdomain's MX routed to 33mail (smtpv2.ec2.33mail.com).
